name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 8 leads at a $216.55 CPL across $1,732.40 in total spend, with Google Ads leading investment at $1,037.40. The biggest movement is a 76.85% week-over-week drop in Instagram spend, likely reflecting a budget pullback or paused creative, while overall weekly spend also declined 21.07%, driven largely by a 32.35% reduction in Google Ads spend.

performance.verdict: Spend is live but leads have nearly stopped; SOW blockers are the real emergency.

findings.text: Only 7 leads in 45 days with $216.55 CPL; last 3 days (Sep 7–9) produced 1 lead on $269.68 spend — volume is critically thin.
Booking bot battle-test overdue since 2026-07-31 and intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an empty seat, making lead quality unmeasurable.
Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA re-enable (heating) all overdue as of 2026-08-31/09-01 — 4 scale-gate deliverables unresolved.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for Sep 7–9 (vs. avg ~5/day earlier in window) while paid spend continued at $71.69 on Sep 9 — organic and paid signals diverging sharply.
IG reach fell from ~250/day in late August to 14 on Sep 9 (-76.85% week-over-week), flat engagement at 0 — creative fatigue probable given sustained spend with no refresh.

suggestions.text: Confirm new intake owner and GHL login this week — unblocks scale-up gate and validates whether 8 leads are being worked.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake owner seat has been unconfirmed since; speed-to-lead automations may be routing to no one. Identify the named replacement, verify their GHL login, and confirm after-hours coverage. Success = named owner confirmed in writing to Nacer/Sohib by 2026-09-17. This is the SOW-stated blocker on all budget scale-up.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions for 3 more days — 0 actions Sep 7–9 may be Windsor data lag; do not act until Sep 13 reading.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three consecutive days (Sep 7–9) after averaging ~5/day earlier in the window. The SOW flags the last 2–3 days of any GBP window as Windsor data lag, so this may not be a real drop. Re-check on 2026-09-13; if actions remain at 0 or below 2/day by then, escalate as a GBP listing issue.

suggestions.text: Refresh Meta creative: IG reach down 76.85% week-over-week; introduce at least one new ad variant before Sep 17.
suggestions.monday_update: Instagram reach collapsed from ~250/day in late August to 14 on Sep 9, a 76.85% weekly drop, with engagement at 0 throughout. This matches a creative fatigue pattern against flat spend. Brief one new creative variant into the active Meta ad set and launch by 2026-09-17. Success check: IG reach recovers above 100/day within 5 days of the new creative going live.
